title: Minigame: A20.54 Prisoners

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the A20.54 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): prisoners under two Guards in a building, their facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): which prisoner may attack its Guard to escape and after what NTC, what a #KIA does to a prisoner it does not eliminate, and what CVP the captor scores for a prisoner, asked on the Rule Workbench.
The Hungarian HS's national borders are the card's fact (A25.82), entered by hand in the checks that read it.

introduction: A20.55's example in a building: a German squad guards a Russian HS; a broken Russian squad guards a Hungarian HS and an Italian HS.

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
